subject.title: fix(slack): restore HTTP event processing after webhook acknowledgement

question: Should independently admitted post-ack webhook work become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for Slack and other plugins?
rationale: The generic boundary is architecturally plausible, but exporting it creates a lasting plugin contract whose ownership and retry semantics cannot be decided safely from tests alone.

options.title: Approve after retry repair
options.body: Keep the narrow generic SDK helper, add local retry ownership and contract documentation, then require live Slack HTTP proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the capability internal
options.body: Replace the public export with an injected core-owned runtime capability if maintainers do not want plugins directly reserving independent gateway work roots.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the regression open while a different acknowledgement or debounce architecture is designed without expanding the SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve after retry repair
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic SDK helper, add local retry ownership and contract documentation, then require live Slack HTTP proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the Slack handler and Plugin SDK boundary implicated by the decision.
